> [!summary] Data available

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈4,180 recipes labelled Greek (region "Greek" 4,185); amounts, steps, nutrition, not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 2,391 recipes tagged `greek` (steps, nutrition, no amounts).
- [[CulinaryDB]]: 934 Greece recipes (ingredients, partial amounts). [[IndicRecipeNutri]]: 107 "Greek" recipes.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 42 dishes (12 Greece-only; souvlaki, gyros, bougatsa); [[FmLAMA]] 22 dishes (381 rows; avgolemono, fasolada, giouvetsi). No [[World Wide Dishes]] entry. Ingredient lists only.
- [[BLEnD]] `Greece` (BLEnD-2024): 105 food questions, 476 answer clusters.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 224 plants on the map; [[NPASS]] 48 species–compound pairs collected in Greece.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 47 rows (36 concentrations, 11 EPIC correlations); no Greek cancer-association rows.
- Traditional use: [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] ETHNOBOT 61 records (60 taxa); [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Greek FCT and no Greek-language recipe corpus.
- Little Greek human-cohort data despite the Mediterranean-diet literature (EPIC-Greece has only 11 correlation rows).
